labels: He would never do that to me.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: `I'm sorry!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]I'm sorry![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Boaris
nodes.text: Stop, stop, `stop` the simulation!
nodes.text_bbcode: Stop, stop, [color=#e23b3b][i]stop[/i][/color] the simulation!

nodes.text: Nick's surprised face freezes on a large screen in Hog Heaven.
Boaris the cupig flies over to glower angrily at $NAMEOFFAMILIAR, who's sitting at a control panel full of buttons in front of a large simulator screen.

nodes.speaker: Boaris
nodes.text: What are you doing? He was just about to officially ask her to be his girlfriend!

nodes.speaker: Pig Bird
nodes.text: I don't know! I pushed the orange button...

nodes.speaker: Boaris
nodes.text: So you thought their romantic moment would be boosted by a 'medium accident'? Do you realize what kind of a pigsty you'd be stuck in if this were real and not just a simulation?!

nodes.speaker: Boaris
nodes.text: Do you know what the Hogfather would do to our pigtails if Sam breaks up with Nick?!

nodes.speaker: Pig Bird
nodes.text: Hey, it's not that bad. I got this. Hold on... I can fix it!
$NAMEOFFAMILIAR scans the panel and selects another button.

nodes.speaker: Pig Bird
nodes.text: What about this one?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Sam, here's a napkin. I'm sor--
Nick stops when he sees an angry Spencer approach the table.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Nick!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Uh, Spencer! Hi!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Nick Brown, are you making Samface sad?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: No, I--
Spencer grabs the front of Nick's shirt and thrusts his fist in Nick's face.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: No, Spencer, wait just a second! It's all a misunder--
The screen pauses once more.

nodes.speaker: Boaris
nodes.text: You brought `Spencer` in?
nodes.text_bbcode: You brought [color=#e23b3b][i]Spencer[/i][/color] in?

nodes.speaker: Pig Bird
nodes.text: Whoops! Wrong button! What about this one?

nodes.speaker: Boaris
nodes.text: `Not that one!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Not that one![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Startled, $NAMEOFFAMILIAR jumps and lands on the entire panel of buttons! Several sparks fly, and an ominous whirring noise emanates from the machine...

nodes.speaker: Pig Bird
nodes.text: Uh oh... It's going haywire!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: --standing! Nothing's wrong here!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Hey, break it up! Give the little guy a break.
Colt steps up to the table and taps Spencer's fist.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Hey! Watch the merchandise.
Spencer drops Nick's shirt, and Nick stumbles back.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Whoa, thanks, Colt... Now I think I can explain everything...

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Shut it, nerd.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I'm not a nerd!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: You're wearing glasses, aren't you?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Not all people who wear glasses are nerds. The stereotypes are changing. At the very `least`, I'm hipster--
nodes.text_bbcode: Not all people who wear glasses are nerds. The stereotypes are changing. At the very [color=#e23b3b][i]least[/i][/color], I'm hipster--

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Yawn. Shut up already, and let's get to the most important part. What was this I heard about you hurting Sam?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I don't see why you care.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Yeah, Colt! You're not her boyfriend anymore.

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Well, maybe I'd like to date her again!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Uh... What?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'm sick of you idiotfaces dating Sam and then hurting her! Clearly `I'm` the only one she should date. We've never had a bad time! And I'm willing to fight for her to prove it!
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm sick of you idiotfaces dating Sam and then hurting her! Clearly [color=#e23b3b][i]I'm[/i][/color] the only one she should date. We've never had a bad time! And I'm willing to fight for her to prove it!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: I'm down.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Hold up, this argument has nothing to do with either of you two! `I'm` the one dating, Sam.
nodes.text_bbcode: Hold up, this argument has nothing to do with either of you two! [color=#e23b3b][i]I'm[/i][/color] the one dating, Sam.

nodes.text: He turns to Sam.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Sam, stop this madness.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, to be honest, I'm really into this `fighting` idea...
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, to be honest, I'm really into this [color=#3b78e2][i]fighting[/i][/color] idea...

nodes.text: Spencer crushes a fist into his hand while Colt rolls up his sleeves.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Let's do this!
Spencer throws a heavy punch at Colt! Colt nimbly ducks around it and decks Spencer!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: `Oof!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Oof![/i][/color]

nodes.text: As Spencer reels back, Colt whirls on a startled Nick!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I'm morally opposed to violence...
Nick strips his jacket off and faces Colt.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: But in this case, I'm making an exception!
Colt rushes forward and tackles Nick onto one of the cafeteria tables! They roll down the length of it, taking out people's lunches left and right!
Nick pushes Colt's face into some mashed potatoes! Colt shoves Nick down and throws milk in his face! They roll off the table!

nodes.speaker: Colt
nodes.text: Give it up, Brown. You're outmatched. You can't take me down...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: `But I can!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]But I can![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Spencer knocks Colt down! Nick just catches his breath when Spencer notices him and pushes him to the floor too!
Nick sees Spencer bend his knees to leap on top of them. He tries to scramble to his feet... But it's too late...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: For Samface!
Spencer jumps in the air... The last thing Nick remembers seeing is the manic gleam in Spencer's eyes...
Whoa, that got out of hand real quick! Nick, Colt, and Spencer all fighting for Sam? Too weird!
That can only mean one thing...
`Happy April Fools Day from the Surviving High School Team!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]Happy April Fools Day from the Surviving High School Team![/b]

nodes.text: Did you miss the cupig's adventures the first time around? Catch them in the Paige and Owen Valentine's episode of `Volume 4: Love and Basketball,` available in the store under 'More Episodes'!
nodes.text_bbcode: Did you miss the cupig's adventures the first time around? Catch them in the Paige and Owen Valentine's episode of [b]Volume 4: Love and Basketball,[/b] available in the store under 'More Episodes'!

nodes.text: And now, onto the `real` episode!
nodes.text_bbcode: And now, onto the [b]real[/b] episode!

nodes.text: Nick grabs the socks and throws them at Sam!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Nick! Ew! Gross!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: These smell horrible!
Nick grabs the crackers and throws them at Sam!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Nick! What are you `doing?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Nick! What are you [color=#3b78e2][i]doing?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: How are `crackers` going to fix this situation?!
nodes.text_bbcode: How are [color=#3b78e2][i]crackers[/i][/color] going to fix this situation?!

nodes.text: Nick panics!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I... I don't know what to do!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Nick! Grab a napkin or something! Anything!
She shoves the phone under the mattress and heads to sleep.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'm not going to break easily... And Jessica `is` going down.
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm not going to break easily... And Jessica [color=#3b78e2][i]is[/i][/color] going down.

nodes.text: Paige whips out the phone and dials Owen's number...
`Ring.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]Ring.[/b]

nodes.text: `Ring.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]Ring.[/b]

nodes.text: `Ring.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [b]Ring.[/b]

nodes.text: It goes to Owen's voicemail message.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: You've reached Owen! Please leave your name after the--
In the recording, the sound of the door opening and closing is heard in the background, then...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Oh, $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Owen, hi! Your grandmother let me in. Are you ready to head out?

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Oh yeah! Let me just turn this phone off--
The recording cuts out abruptly, transitioning into an obnoxious `Beep!`
nodes.text_bbcode: The recording cuts out abruptly, transitioning into an obnoxious [b]Beep![/b]

nodes.text: Paige hangs up.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What was I even expecting?
Paige resists.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I don't need him, and I don't need to talk to him.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: But she's `so` manipulative...
nodes.text_bbcode: But she's [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] manipulative...

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: I mean, I don't even remember `why` I'm knitting her this quilt, but I can't bring myself to stop!
nodes.text_bbcode: I mean, I don't even remember [color=#3b78e2][i]why[/i][/color] I'm knitting her this quilt, but I can't bring myself to stop!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You don't think I can get more cute, rich boys than her?!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'll give you that she's manipulative, but so am I. She's nothing. She's not even that rich.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Well, if you beat her, Whitford will have to let you go to the Debutante Dance for Spring Break!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: That's great!

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: The hotel overlooks Centerscore Beach!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah, Centerscore...
For a second, Paige thinks of `him...`
nodes.text_bbcode: For a second, Paige thinks of [b]him...[/b]

nodes.text: But then she remembers where she is.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: The beach is going to be so much more amazing without Jessica!
Prissy and Penelope chatter on about how fantastic their Spring Break trip is going to be...
While Paige broods.
Later, when Paige is alone in her room...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'm certainly not in this competition to see `him`...
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm certainly not in this competition to see [color=#3b78e2][i]him[/i][/color]...

nodes.text: She suddenly thinks of Owen smiling down at her...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Here you go.
Owen hands Paige the flowers.
For a second, she grips the phone in her pocket. It'd be so easy to dial Owen's number and talk to him...

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Uh-huh. Focused like you were the last month? Or what about tonight?

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: You had no idea what a Perfect was until dinner...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Whatever. Prissy, I can handle her.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I've done something Jessica has never figured out how to do.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: And that makes me smarter than she is.
Paige hesitates.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Uh... I'm more focused?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Better make way at the top... Or else it's going to get awfully crowded.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Oh yeah?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You know, we can drag this out over several months, curry favors, set each other up...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: But there's a much easier way to settle this. The Emerald Ball's just about the `perfect` time for us girls to show off our `Monarch Prep values`, don't you think?
nodes.text_bbcode: But there's a much easier way to settle this. The Emerald Ball's just about the [color=#3b78e2][i]perfect[/i][/color] time for us girls to show off our [color=#3b78e2][i]Monarch Prep values[/i][/color], don't you think?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Get to the point.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: The point is that there will be guys at this Ball interested in girls like us. Why don't we let them decide who deserves to rule Monarch Prep?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You mean a competition? Because if that's the case, you're going down.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Diamonds sparkle, and so do I. When I'm done, there won't be a guy there who isn't enchanted with me.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: So enough with the posturing... What's the wager?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Straight and simple. Whichever girl has the most guys on her side of the ballroom by the time Whitford makes the evening toast wins.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Deal.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I can't say I haven't been looking forward to this moment...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I suppose you'll be wanting this back.
Paige flashes her the phone, but Jessica shakes her head.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: No, sweetie. That's yours. I insist. From one friend...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: To another.
Later that night, Paige and her friends hang out in her room. On the floor, Prissy knits a large quilt while Paige and Penelope sprawl on the bed.

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: It was very brave standing up to her...

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Brave... Or stupid?

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: Maybe both!

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Do you honestly think you can beat Jessica?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Are you kidding me? Jessica doesn't stand a chance...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: She's going to lose, and when she does, I'm going to be there to sweep everything out from under her. That means the boys, the school, and her `stupid` title.
nodes.text_bbcode: She's going to lose, and when she does, I'm going to be there to sweep everything out from under her. That means the boys, the school, and her [color=#3b78e2][i]stupid[/i][/color] title.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Because there's one thing I definitely have over her...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Yeah, he would. He already did.
Paige is surprised to find out that Jessica's words sting now just as much as they did in her dream.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: He can't break up with me. We were never together to begin with. And however you interpret it...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Owen's behind me now. I have something more important to focus on...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: `Your` spot.
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Your[/i][/color] spot.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Owen was a fine distraction while I was at Centerscore...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I mean, come on, he's hot.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I don't doubt that.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: But looking at him now, he's also easily distracted, and the only pitiful thing I've done is waited this long to figure it out.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I deserve the best...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: And what I'm going for is your position.
Off-balance, Paige struggles to think of something to say.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Uh... Uh...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Owen would never do that to me!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Well, you `have` changed after being out there in the big, bad world, haven't you?
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, you [color=#3b78e2][i]have[/i][/color] changed after being out there in the big, bad world, haven't you?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: So tell me... Did you find him? You know, the guy you're totes crushing on?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Oh, I found him all right.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: And now you're back. You know, escaping from this facility, even just for a few hours, gives you a lot of credibility...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: So I'll extend my original offer. You can be my friend...
She produces a phone, and Paige knows in her gut that `this` one works.
nodes.text_bbcode: She produces a phone, and Paige knows in her gut that [b]this[/b] one works.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: ...And I'll be yours.
Paige takes the phone and smiles.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Thanks, Jessica. I'll take it... As tribute.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: As `tribute?`
nodes.text_bbcode: As [color=#3b78e2][i]tribute?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah. You know, like a gift from a servant to her leader.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: What does that mean?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Let's just say that there's been a change of plans... And there's a new queen of Monarch Prep now.
Jessica sinks back in her plush chair, her arms crossed.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Oh, this is rich. Richer than all of the girls here put together.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You're challenging me? You have no idea what you're getting yourself into. You've had your head stuck in the clouds about Owen, and you don't know the rules of the game.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I'm `Perfect`, and there's nothing you can do to cross me.
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]Perfect[/i][/color], and there's nothing you can do to cross me.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: 'Perfect'? Please. Get over yourself.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: That's what I thought. You have no idea, do you? I'm `the` Perfect. That's a title I earned here at Monarch Prep, and that means I have power and perks. Power you don't know anything about.
nodes.text_bbcode: That's what I thought. You have no idea, do you? I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]the[/i][/color] Perfect. That's a title I earned here at Monarch Prep, and that means I have power and perks. Power you don't know anything about.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: So 'Perfect' is like what? A British school `prefect?`
nodes.text_bbcode: So 'Perfect' is like what? A British school [color=#3b78e2][i]prefect?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Sure. Only way more `perfect`, obviously.
nodes.text_bbcode: Sure. Only way more [color=#3b78e2][i]perfect[/i][/color], obviously.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: The point is, don't cross me. Because `I` decide who goes...
nodes.text_bbcode: The point is, don't cross me. Because [color=#3b78e2][i]I[/i][/color] decide who goes...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: And who `stays.`
nodes.text_bbcode: And who [color=#3b78e2][i]stays.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What are you talking about?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You'll see...
Jessica points to the door as Whitford sweeps into the room and stands in front of all the girls, her hands clasped together.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Girls, I have an important announcement to make... The Emerald Ball is happening this weekend!
Excitement titters around the room, and Whitford raises a hand to quiet everyone.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: As you know, the Emerald Ball is an event that brings together society's brightest gems from the country's most distinguished schools.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Members from the school board and gentleman from other schools will be there to evaluate you, so this is an opportunity for every lady here to demonstrate good behavior.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Those of you who do particularly well will earn the opportunity to enjoy another event down the line... Which I'm sure your `Perfect` will explain in more depth.
nodes.text_bbcode: Those of you who do particularly well will earn the opportunity to enjoy another event down the line... Which I'm sure your [color=#3b78e2][i]Perfect[/i][/color] will explain in more depth.

nodes.text: Whitford gestures to Jessica, who steps up with a smile.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Our dear Principal Whitford is talking about Spring Break!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: This year, two ladies who demonstrate the best Monarch Prep values at the Emerald Ball will get to travel, parents permitting, to an exclusive resort near Centerscore Beach to attend the famous Debutante Dance!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: As `Perfect,` I'll be helping Principal Whitford hand select the right ladies for the trip. So be good now!
nodes.text_bbcode: As [color=#3b78e2][i]Perfect,[/i][/color] I'll be helping Principal Whitford hand select the right ladies for the trip. So be good now!

nodes.text: Jessica steps down and slides into the seat across from Paige as Whitford leaves the room.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: So... Has someone changed their mind about being nice to me?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: No, but it's pretty clear that they're setting the bar low for perfection these days...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You know what, Paige? I've tried to be nice to you. I invited you to my table, I invited you to my parties...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I'll just consider tonight as a mistake. You must be so tired after being locked up in isolation for eight hours.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Uh-huh.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: But mark my words... Monarch Prep is `mine`, and the Emerald Ball is where `I'm` going to shine.
nodes.text_bbcode: But mark my words... Monarch Prep is [color=#3b78e2][i]mine[/i][/color], and the Emerald Ball is where [color=#3b78e2][i]I'm[/i][/color] going to shine.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You've become weak over some `boy` who's more interested in a goody-two-shoes Juliet than `you.`
nodes.text_bbcode: You've become weak over some [color=#3b78e2][i]boy[/i][/color] who's more interested in a goody-two-shoes Juliet than [color=#3b78e2][i]you.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: 'Juliet'? How'd you find out about that?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I'm `Perfect.` I know things.
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm [color=#3b78e2][i]Perfect.[/i][/color] I know things.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: And I know why you're going for this pitiful power play... It's because Owen's dumped you.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Owen didn't `dump` me...
nodes.text_bbcode: Owen didn't [color=#3b78e2][i]dump[/i][/color] me...

options.label: He would never do that to me.

nodes.text: Paige turns away from Jessica and sits with Prissy and Penelope.

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: Paige! You're back! Is what everyone's saying true? You did escape?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yes, I did.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: So, if you escaped, why are you here?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I came back because Monarch Prep is my home. This is where I belong. And I'm not going to sit around anymore.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Jessica had better watch her back if she thinks she can be queen bee while I'm here.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Well, you're certainly not going to beat her by sitting with us.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What? Why not?

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: If you're going to challenge Jessica, you should do it face-to-face. Instead of being at Jessica's beck and call.
Prissy points to the center table where Jessica is beckoning Paige over.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: She's waving for you. You better get to her.
Paige gets up and heads to Jessica's table, moving slowly to spite her. When Paige finally sits down, Jessica grins.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: There you are. I've been summoning you for forever.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: No one `summons` me.
nodes.text_bbcode: No one [color=#3b78e2][i]summons[/i][/color] me.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ooh, `feisty` Paige. This is fun.
nodes.text_bbcode: Ooh, [color=#3b78e2][i]feisty[/i][/color] Paige. This is fun.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: If you think it's fun now, let's see how you feel at the end of the night.
Paige walks up to Jessica's table and casually takes a seat.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I don't recall extending an invitation...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Well, your memory must be working because you didn't. I invited myself.
For a second, Jessica just stares at Paige, trying to figure out the best way to respond...
Then she smiles.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Well-played. I like you acting all feisty. You may sit here.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I don't really need your permission either.
Paige does one last extra push-up, rolls over, and starts doing sit-ups!
Hour eight.
By the time the dinner bell rings and her door opens, Paige is more than ready...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: It all starts `now.`
nodes.text_bbcode: It all starts [color=#3b78e2][i]now.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: At dinner that evening, Paige pauses before entering the cafeteria.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: All right... If I'm going to rip the red carpet out from under Jessica's feet, I'll need to make a dramatic entrance...
Paige throws the doors open. They bang against the walls as she strides into the room confidently, her head held high. As soon as people notice her, whispers rise like a tide around her.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: And check that off my list.

nodes.speaker: Madisenn
nodes.text: Is that Paige? Where has she been?

nodes.speaker: Caroline
nodes.text: I heard she was in isolation all day...

nodes.speaker: Madisenn
nodes.text: For what?

nodes.speaker: Caroline
nodes.text: Well, people are saying that she escaped from Monarch...
As they chatter on, Paige searches the room for a place to sit.
On one side, she sees an empty seat next to Prissy and Penelope. In the center, she sees a seat at Jessica's table. Jessica smiles smugly at her.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Ugh, is it better to confront Jessica by sitting next to her or by ignoring her and pretending I don't care about her at all?
Paige falls!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: `Oof!`

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: That's not going to be good enough... Let's do that again!
Paige's arms buckle! She falls!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: `Ow!`
Despite the pain, she crawls back into pushup position.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Let's do that again!
Paige's arms wobble, and she falls flat on her face!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Erg!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Why is this so hard?! Okay... Five from the top!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Whitford may not think I'm a society girl, and Jessica doesn't think I'm in charge...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Well, they don't know everything!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I `do` belong at Monarch Prep...
nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#3b78e2][i]do[/i][/color] belong at Monarch Prep...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: And I can prove it by taking Jessica `down`...
nodes.text_bbcode: And I can prove it by taking Jessica [color=#3b78e2][i]down[/i][/color]...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: When I'm through with her, she won't be asking for favors, getting her contraband, or having anyone at her beck and call...
As Paige thinks about how to topple Jessica, she trains. She gets down on the floor and does a...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Yeah... That's exactly it. I deserve better.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Owen's not interested in me... So there's nothing out there for me to do.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Which means I'm supposed to be here.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Wait, that seems wrong. If I don't belong here, I should try escaping...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: But what would I escape to? Owen's not interested in me...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Here is where I'm supposed to be!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Uh... I, uh, think... Shoot, I forgot.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Maybe it's that I don't belong here?
Whitford regards Paige... And whatever she sees in Paige's eyes makes her nod her head.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: I don't know exactly what you're after, Paige. But know this... You will be treated better when you prove to me that you've changed.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: That means not trying to escape, blending in with the other girls, and behaving well at public functions...
Whitford sniffs.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: I'm not certain you'll be able to redeem yourself fully... But you can certainly try.
Paige nods.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: At any rate, now that you're back, we'll have to give you a suitable punishment. You'll be kept in our isolation wing all day tomorrow from dawn until dinner.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: You'll spend your time alone, eat your meals alone, and think completely alone until you grasp the severity of what you've done.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: I hope your time in solitary will help you figure out how to behave like you belong.
Whitford turns and leaves. With a sympathetic look in his face, Brock opens the door and nudges Paige in.

nodes.speaker: Brock
nodes.text: Girl. Think. Hard.
Brock closes the door, leaving Paige in the lonely isolation wing of the Butterfly Detention Center.
In the darkness, alone, Paige curls up on her bed...
And sleeps.
The next morning, Paige wakes up to a bleak morning and an empty room. She hears nothing, and when she tries the door, it's locked.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Oh, right. I'm in isolation... Dawn until dinnertime? That's only eight hours. No problem.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I can last until dinner...
Hour one.
Paige taps her foot on the floor, paces the length of the room, and taps it again.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: This is fine. I'm fine.
Hour two.
Paige flops on the floor and stares at the ceiling, trying to see shapes in it.
But frustratingly, all she can see is Owen...
...Kissing $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Arg!
Hour three.
On the bed, Paige closes her eyes, trying to rest... But $ZOE and Owen's kiss flashes through her head!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: It was exactly the same way he kissed `me` on `Valentine's Day!`
nodes.text_bbcode: It was exactly the same way he kissed [color=#3b78e2][i]me[/i][/color] on [color=#3b78e2][i]Valentine's Day![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: `Ugh!` He's `so` lame! He only has one move!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Ugh![/i][/color] He's [color=#3b78e2][i]so[/i][/color] lame! He only has one move!

nodes.text: Hour four.
Paige is just frustrated enough to consider escaping again when a knock at the door startles her. She opens it to find Brock with a tray of food.

nodes.speaker: Brock
nodes.text: Here. Girl. Food.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Girl no `want` food, Brock. Girl wants out of solitary.
nodes.text_bbcode: Girl no [color=#3b78e2][i]want[/i][/color] food, Brock. Girl wants out of solitary.

nodes.speaker: Brock
nodes.text: Can't. Help. Girl.

nodes.speaker: Brock
nodes.text: Girl. Help. Self.

nodes.speaker: Brock
nodes.text: Trust. Self. Girl.
Brock leaves her with the tray. She sniffs it, but it seems gray and unappealing. As the door closes behind him, Paige throws the tray away from her in disgust.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I thought you'd help me out, Brock! Remember, I helped you! I thought we had an understanding!
Hour five.
Paige stands in a lobby.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Wait... This is the Twin Branches auditorium!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I thought I was at Monarch Prep... But I'm still here!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Unless I'm dreaming about being `here...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Unless I'm dreaming about being [color=#3b78e2][i]here...[/i][/color]

nodes.text: She waits a moment for something strangely dreamlike to happen. But it doesn't.
Cautiously, she throws open the doors to the theater...
And walks in on $ZOE and Owen making out onstage!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Aw, crap. This `is` a dream!
nodes.text_bbcode: Aw, crap. This [color=#3b78e2][i]is[/i][/color] a dream!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Is it really?
Jessica appears next to Paige.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Well, now it's mostly a nightmare.
Onstage, the kiss freezes, Owen's hands framing $ZOE's face... Jessica clucks her tongue.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Isn't that sweet? While you're pining away over here at Monarch Prep, letting me run all over you, poorman whats-his-face moved on. Like you didn't mean a thing.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Owen wouldn't do that to me.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Yeah, he would. He already did. But it's okay to stay hung up on him. Because the longer you do, the longer this place is mine.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Monarch Prep isn't yours...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: It's totes cute that you believe that! But haven't you been listening?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You're not a threat. I just told you that you won't be able to `redeem yourself fully` enough to be one.
nodes.text_bbcode: You're not a threat. I just told you that you won't be able to [color=#3b78e2][i]redeem yourself fully[/i][/color] enough to be one.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You didn't say that... That was Whitford.
She glares at Jessica... But Whitford is standing in her place!

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: You're right, it was. And you won't be able to redeem yourself as long as you're hung up on Owen...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Ah!
Paige wakes up, sharply and suddenly. She looks around the room, looking for any sign of Whitford or Jessica...
But she is alone.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Ugh, even in my dreams Jessica and Whitford are annoying...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: But they're right... I've been way too caught up with that two-timer Owen! Whitford doesn't think I can reform, and Jessica's been walking all over `my` school!
nodes.text_bbcode: But they're right... I've been way too caught up with that two-timer Owen! Whitford doesn't think I can reform, and Jessica's been walking all over [color=#3b78e2][i]my[/i][/color] school!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I may have been distracted by Owen before... But not anymore!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: If he wants to tongue wrestle with $ZOE, then I don't want anything to do with him...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: And if I were honest with myself, I'd say that...

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: You just came to that conclusion all on your own, did you?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Uh, yes? It's like what you said when you found me at Twin Branches. You told me it was time to go home. I believe it now.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: I don't believe that you've changed your mind just like that. Change is something you see in action.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: A girl who `says` she's reformed must be planning something devious.
nodes.text_bbcode: A girl who [color=#3b78e2][i]says[/i][/color] she's reformed must be planning something devious.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: I'm onto you.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: But it's true! Everything I want is here.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I left trying to find something, `someone`... But when I got to him, everything changed. And I realized that the outside world is not where I'm supposed to be.
nodes.text_bbcode: I left trying to find something, [color=#3b78e2][i]someone[/i][/color]... But when I got to him, everything changed. And I realized that the outside world is not where I'm supposed to be.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'm a society girl, Principal Whitford. I have riches, I have resources, and I have power. That's what I was born to.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Everything I want is right in here.
You are now playing as Paige.
Deep in the Butterfly Detention Center facility, Brock and Principal Whitford usher Paige down a long hallway.

nodes.speaker: Caroline
nodes.text: You don't have to grab my wrist so hard, Brock. I came back `willingly.`
nodes.text_bbcode: You don't have to grab my wrist so hard, Brock. I came back [color=#3b78e2][i]willingly.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Brock looks down at her sadly.

nodes.speaker: Brock
nodes.text: But. Girl. Run.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Not anymore.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: It's not like I have anywhere else to go...
They stop abruptly, pushing Paige in front of an imposing door.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Paige, do you know where we are?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: In front of a door?

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: This is our isolation room at Monarch Prep.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: I shouldn't have to tell you that you're in serious trouble. You've violated half a dozen school rules during your trip to the outside world.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: And despite what your parents generously donate to our private paradise here, you won't be getting off unscathed. What do you say to that?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I understand, Principal Whitford.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: What? No sarcastic remarks? No witty comments?

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: I hope you enjoyed that little taste of freedom because it's unlikely that you're going to see anything outside these gates in a long while.
Paige thinks of Owen holding $ZOE and pulling her close for that kiss... Paige balks.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Ugh... `That's` something I never want to see again.
nodes.text_bbcode: Ugh... [color=#3b78e2][i]That's[/i][/color] something I never want to see again.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'm not going to be a problem from now on...

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: A likely story! What are you trying to pull?

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Don't think that because you escaped once, you'll be able to escape a second time! This time around, I'll make sure that you don't make it past your dorm room door!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You don't have to do that.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: And why not? Why should I trust you? What are you plotting?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'm not plotting anything. It's just on the car ride back from Centerscore, I realized something...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Oh, uh, yeah? I'll join up with you soon... I think.
Preston walks off.
For the next hour, Paige works on flirting, cajoling, and bullying other boys onto her side of the room.
Paige even gets an ex-boyfriend to join her!

nodes.text: Well, when you put it like `that...`
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, when you put it like [color=#e23b3b][i]that...[/i][/color]

nodes.text: And of course, Paige recruits her friends!

nodes.speaker: Caroline
nodes.text: I want to dance!

nodes.speaker: Madisenn
nodes.text: Me too!

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: So tell me about this `Lee` guy!
nodes.text_bbcode: So tell me about this [color=#3b78e2][i]Lee[/i][/color] guy!

nodes.text: By the time Whitford stands up on the podium to make her toast, there's a raucous party over by the dance floor!
While on the other side of the ballroom...
Jessica stands by the food table alone, desperately trying to serve out hors d'oeuvres to get people to stay on her side.

nodes.text: She's blaming me to get out of trouble, Principal Whitford. You know she's always trying to escape.
Whitford glances from Paige to Jessica and nods.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Come with me at once. We're going to settle this matter once and for all!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Principal, there's nothing in my room, I swear!
But Whitford's got one hand on Paige's arm. Leading a small trail of curious girls, Whitford drags Paige all the way back to her room in the dorms.
Paige glares at Jessica who smiles at her wickedly.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Well, let's see it then. Where's the phone?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: She's hiding it.
Jessica kicks over Paige's mattress...
And finds nothing!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: See? I told you! Jessica's trying to set me up.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Where is it?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Clearly, it's `hidden.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Clearly, it's [color=#3b78e2][i]hidden.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Jessica nods to one of the girls in her group, a meek girl named Amber. Amber discreetly dips her hand into her purse and uses her own contraband phone to call the phone that Jessica has given to Paige.
Somewhere, a phone buzzes incessantly...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: It's here, Whitford! I can hear it!
Whitford stops to listen to its location...

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: It's not in this room.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: It's... It's not?
Whitford walks down the hall as the phone keeps buzzing. She stops in front of Jessica's room and gives the Perfect a stern look.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Why is the phone coming from your room?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: I, uh... I don't know!
As Whitford uses her key on the door and opens it, Jessica glances at Paige... Who's smiling wickedly at her.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You are going to `pay` for th--
nodes.text_bbcode: You are going to [color=#3b78e2][i]pay[/i][/color] for th--

nodes.text: Whitford storms out of the room, holding the ringing cell phone.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: What's the meaning of this, Jessica?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Whitford, I swear, it's not my phone!
Whitford glances down at it, examining the phone.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: If it isn't your phone, then why are there texts with your name on them addressed to... Ryan-licious?

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: And why does he assume you're 'running off together to French so hard that we start wearing berets'?!
Whitford shows Jessica the screen, and Jessica sees a wall of texts sent by and to 'Jessica Blaire'...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: But those are--

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: And if this isn't your phone, then what is `this?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: And if this isn't your phone, then what is [color=#3b78e2][i]this?![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Whitford shows Jessica the back of the phone where the incriminating initials 'J.B.' are written in glitter across the back.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Uh, I... Er...

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: These initials look familiar...
And suddenly Whitford's eyes narrow.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: The speakers from the party the night that Paige left. Those were yours too, weren't they?

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: And to think of the horrors that poor Jane Brovlosky has endured in Deluxe Isolation due to your treachery!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Those were Jane's speakers! Why would I lie about that?

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: To avoid getting stripped of your ranking and put into isolation?!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Er, well, `yes,` that is a good reason. But I swear, Principal, those speakers aren't mine, and that phone definitely `isn't` mine!
nodes.text_bbcode: Er, well, [color=#3b78e2][i]yes,[/i][/color] that is a good reason. But I swear, Principal, those speakers aren't mine, and that phone definitely [color=#3b78e2][i]isn't[/i][/color] mine!

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: `Somehow` I don't quite believe you...
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Somehow[/i][/color] I don't quite believe you...

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Paige... Girls... You may go. Little Miss `Perfect` and I need to have a chat...
nodes.text_bbcode: Paige... Girls... You may go. Little Miss [color=#3b78e2][i]Perfect[/i][/color] and I need to have a chat...

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: And it starts with taking away that title of yours... You've abused the system I've set up for you... And you no longer deserve to run it.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: No!
Jessica turns to run and rams straight into Brock!

nodes.speaker: Brock
nodes.text: Girl. In. Trouble.
As Brock and Whitford haul Jessica off, the other girls crowd around Paige and cheer.

nodes.speaker: Caroline
nodes.text: She's gone!

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: You set her up!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Actually, she set `me` up. I just turned the tables.
nodes.text_bbcode: Actually, she set [color=#3b78e2][i]me[/i][/color] up. I just turned the tables.

nodes.speaker: Madisenn
nodes.text: Paige is `in charge!` Woo!
nodes.text_bbcode: Paige is [color=#3b78e2][i]in charge![/i][/color] Woo!

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Yeah. Great. If you like switching one dictator in for another...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Lighten up, Priss. Jealousy doesn't look good on you.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Or do you really feel like crossing the new `Perfect` of Monarch Prep?
nodes.text_bbcode: Or do you really feel like crossing the new [color=#3b78e2][i]Perfect[/i][/color] of Monarch Prep?

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: You haven't earned it yet...

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: But I suppose I'm not going to put it past you.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: It's good to see you back to your normal self.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Thanks... It's good to be back.
In the weeks that follow, things `do` change around Monarch Prep...
nodes.text_bbcode: In the weeks that follow, things [b]do[/b] change around Monarch Prep...

nodes.text: Jessica is dismissed from her position and becomes a regular student in the detention center...

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: After asking the girls questions about the recent contraband in your room...

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: I was `shocked` to discover that you've been extorting supplies and blankets from them for weeks!
nodes.text_bbcode: I was [color=#3b78e2][i]shocked[/i][/color] to discover that you've been extorting supplies and blankets from them for weeks!

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: In addition to the time you'll be serving in isolation, you'll also be required to do community service...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: No! I can't... I'm not cut out for work...
Whitford looks to Brock.

nodes.speaker: Brock
nodes.text: Do. Push-ups. Now.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Not again...
And Paige wins the title of `Perfect.`
nodes.text_bbcode: And Paige wins the title of [b]Perfect.[/b]

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I have to say... `Perfect Paige` has a nice ring to it. Don't you think?
nodes.text_bbcode: I have to say... [color=#3b78e2][i]Perfect Paige[/i][/color] has a nice ring to it. Don't you think?

nodes.speaker: Penelope
nodes.text: I like it.

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Panderer.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What was that?

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Nothing!
And life at Monarch Prep becomes more bearable for Paige...
Until one day at lunch...
Principal Whitford calls Paige into her office.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Principal Whitford? You wanted to see me?

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Yes. Perfect, I don't think I ever congratulated you on earning your title, did I?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'm not sure...

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: No, I didn't. Congratulations. You know, I had my doubts.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Excuse me?

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: When we recovered you from outside, Paige, I had some doubts about your true intentions... But with you here, I now see that you represent the finest that Monarch Prep has to offer.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Thanks. Is that all?

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: No. As Perfect, you get certain benefits associated with your position. And one of those benefits is getting to receive visitors...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'm allowed to see people? From the outside?

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Yes.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: So that's how Jessica's been in contact with the outside world...

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Incidentally, you have a few visitors...
Whitford stands up and goes up to a door leading into a conference room.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: In here.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: But who's visiting `me?`
nodes.text_bbcode: But who's visiting [color=#3b78e2][i]me?[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Paige pauses just outside the door...
And flings it open!
Margot and Tad sit stiff-backed against plush velvet seats. They turn to Paige as she enters the room.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Mom? Tad? I thought you guys were traveling in Italy.

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: We came back early.

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: It was far too Italian over there...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: But what are you doing `here` at Monarch?
nodes.text_bbcode: But what are you doing [color=#3b78e2][i]here[/i][/color] at Monarch?

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: Imagine our surprise to receive a voice message from Principal Whitford asking for our permission for you to leave Monarch Prep during Spring Break.

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: I was going to pen her a strongly worded letter to tell her that you were under no circumstances to leave the school...

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: But the principal also mentioned that you'd recently had the honor of becoming a school `Prefect!`
nodes.text_bbcode: But the principal also mentioned that you'd recently had the honor of becoming a school [color=#e23b3b][i]Prefect![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Actually, the term is `Perfect,` Tad.
nodes.text_bbcode: Actually, the term is [color=#3b78e2][i]Perfect,[/i][/color] Tad.

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: 'Perfect'? That's a bit odd, isn't it?

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: I think it's wonderful. And we just had to see for ourselves what had changed...

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: If anything.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: If I'm going to keep my position at the top, I have to go on this trip... But how do I get my parents to go for it?

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: So tell us more about this Centerscore Beach trip. I thought we sent you to a disciplinary school, not a recreational one...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: So what? Why should I care?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Because I'll carry it until the day I graduate and then for years after!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You'll be known forever as that girl who didn't keep her promises!

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: That's fine! Go ahead and stay mad at me! I love it. I `relish` it.
nodes.text_bbcode: That's fine! Go ahead and stay mad at me! I love it. I [color=#3b78e2][i]relish[/i][/color] it.

nodes.text: Paige doesn't know what to say to that.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I, uh...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: The wind gone out of your yacht sails? Good.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'm not done. I'm not the only one who'll resent you for tonight. Everyone else will too.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Because when it comes down to it...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: So what? Why should I care?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Because everyone heard you issue that challenge to me at dinner a couple nights ago.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You promised that we'd settle this tonight. And it's clear I've won.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: People don't like it when promises are broken.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: It tends to make people think you're unreliable. They won't listen to you now, Jessica, and without them, you have no power.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Face it...
Whitford clears her throat on the stage.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Welcome, ladies and gentlemen,to the eightieth anniversary of the Emerald Ball, the precursor to our famed Debutante Dance...
As Whitford prattles about school tradition in an attempt to impress the school board members, Jessica storms up to Paige.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: There you are! I was wondering where you'd gone, `Jess.` Things are looking a little lonely on your side, aren't they?
nodes.text_bbcode: There you are! I was wondering where you'd gone, [color=#3b78e2][i]Jess.[/i][/color] Things are looking a little lonely on your side, aren't they?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Shut up. This proves nothing.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: It proves everything...

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: That's just too bad. You may have won this little display, but you can forget me handing anything over. I'm still Perfect, and I still run this school.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: So you're going back on our deal?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You can't really be that surprised.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'm not... But Jessica, you should know that...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Uh... Yes? I'll, uh, see you on the dance floor then? Maybe?
Preston walks off.
For the next hour, Paige tries unsuccessfully to get guys onto her side of the room.

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: Paige?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Lee? Uh... Would you like to hang out... Somewhere near the dance floor?

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: Uh, sorry, Paige... I just don't think it's a good idea...

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: Setting aside our whole relationship history, you've been weirding everybody out.
With just a few minutes left to go, Paige realizes that all of the boys are on Jessica's side of the room!

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Did I tell you about the `old` versus `gold` watch and my rich father?
nodes.text_bbcode: Did I tell you about the [color=#e23b3b][i]old[/i][/color] versus [color=#e23b3b][i]gold[/i][/color] watch and my rich father?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Ooh, no... `Do` tell... And have a canape while you're at it.
nodes.text_bbcode: Ooh, no... [color=#3b78e2][i]Do[/i][/color] tell... And have a canape while you're at it.

nodes.text: Desperately, Paige yells into the crowded ballroom...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Does anyone want to hang out on this side of the room?!
Even Paige's friends desert her...

nodes.speaker: Prissy
nodes.text: Sorry, Paige...

nodes.speaker: Caroline
nodes.text: All the boys are on Jessica's side!
And by the time Whitford stands up on the podium to make her toast, something inside Paige deflates.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Looks a little lonely over there, Paige.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Want to join the real party over here?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: All you have to do is bring one of those speakers over here... As `tribute.`
nodes.text_bbcode: All you have to do is bring one of those speakers over here... As [color=#3b78e2][i]tribute.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: With a heavy heart, Paige trudges to the speaker, knowing...
She has failed.

nodes.prompt: What do you want to do?

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: What do you want to do?

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: No! No! No!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: I'm not an `astrologist!` Astrology is not a viable field of science, and I refuse to be lumped in with that hogwash!
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm not an [color=#e23b3b][i]astrologist![/i][/color] Astrology is not a viable field of science, and I refuse to be lumped in with that hogwash!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Oh, uh, sorry? So what about that dance floor?

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: Is the Andromeda galaxy elliptical?

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: That's... That's right! I'm so... Surprised!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: By what?

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: Well, girls like you don't usually talk to, uh... Astronomists like myself. I don't exactly have that... `gravitational pull.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, girls like you don't usually talk to, uh... Astronomists like myself. I don't exactly have that... [color=#e23b3b][i]gravitational pull.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Sure you do. I want to hear more... On the dance floor. Will you be there?

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: Is Proxima Centauri 4.2 light-years away?
Paige blanks out.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Uh... Uh... An astrologist?
Paige looks to Preston.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: And last but not least... The nerd...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Coming, Preston?

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: Dancing's not my thing.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Not your thing? And what is?

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: Science is.
Paige looks him over and notices a star pin on his jacket lapel.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Let me guess. You study stars. You're an...
Carson gives her a smile that lets Paige know she's hit his weak point.

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: You like them?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Cream wing-tipped oxfords with a handmade brass antique heel? That must have been a fortune. They're classic.

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: A true connoisseur. I appreciate it. These shoes are my pride and joy... Along with the fourteen other pairs I have that are just like them!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: And you know where I think they'd go best?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: On a dance floor.

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: I guess I can't argue with that. I'll make my way over.
Carson heads away to Paige's side of the room.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: They're so... Brown.

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Really? But brown is so... Common.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Oh, did I say brown? I meant... Coppery. Copperish. Copper-colored?

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Copper... As in the cheap metal that pennies are made of?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Hey, it's a nice color, isn't it?

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: I always thought of my eyes as a nice hazel color.
Paige can see she's hurt his feelings and tries to change the subject.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: So... I don't suppose you want to dance?

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: I spy with my `hazel` eye... Somewhere else to be.
nodes.text_bbcode: I spy with my [color=#e23b3b][i]hazel[/i][/color] eye... Somewhere else to be.

nodes.text: Carson strides off.
Paige feels she's run out of time! She chooses the first thing that comes to mind...

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Nice what?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Nice eyes!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: So I want to dance, but the floor's looking pretty lonely. I was hoping I could convince some of you to start the party...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What do you say?
Mark kisses Paige's hand.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Uh, that's... An interesting move you got there. Nice hand kiss.

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Oh, thanks. I don't think anyone's said that before.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'll be the first.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: And you know, you seem like a really nice guy.

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Nice? Yeah, uh, great...
Paige can tell her compliments aren't working. Mark looks anywhere but at Paige.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Being nice isn't doing anything for me! This is why $ZOE sucks!
Paige tries to get his attention back.
Paige pulls her hand away from Mark. He kisses his own by accident!

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Wait, what?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Hey, you're moving pretty fast there, ace. I don't know if you and I are at that level yet.
She turns to Preston and Carson.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You'd better watch the mouth on this one...

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Ha ha, man... She has your number.

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: Uh-huh... I appreciate a girl who plays hard-to-get.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I don't know why guys always think that... But it's making this `way` easy...
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't know why guys always think that... But it's making this [color=#3b78e2][i]way[/i][/color] easy...

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: So, Paige... What'll it take to get to `that level?`
nodes.text_bbcode: So, Paige... What'll it take to get to [color=#e23b3b][i]that level?[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: A million years.
The boys laugh.

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: Ouch!

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: Ha ha!

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: `Touche.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Touche.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Paige freaks out and pauses!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: What do I do? I guess I'll just... Be nice to him?
Paige rushes onto the dance floor...
Where she finds Jessica at the center of a crowd of guys.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: There you are! I was wondering if you'd bother showing up.
She turns away from the boys to address Paige fully.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Of course I will. Whitford just had this interesting notion that I'd be trouble tonight.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Well, you did try to escape.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Wrong. I did escape.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Whatevs. Are you ready to do this?

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: You and me. We split up the room from that statue over there in the middle--

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I get the side with the dance floor.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: --Fine. I'll take the side with the hors d'oeuvres.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: Whoever has the most guys on her side by the celebratory toast in an hour wins.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Great.

nodes.speaker: Jessica
nodes.text: `Great.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Great.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: They part, and Paige finds three guys talking near the statue in the center of the room.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Those look like tempting targets.
Paige sizes the three boys up.

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: And then this girl told me that she wanted an `old` watch, not a `gold` watch. I dropped her like a hot tomato. Backbutter doesn't have time for chicks playing games.
nodes.text_bbcode: And then this girl told me that she wanted an [color=#e23b3b][i]old[/i][/color] watch, not a [color=#e23b3b][i]gold[/i][/color] watch. I dropped her like a hot tomato. Backbutter doesn't have time for chicks playing games.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Big ego hotshot. Used to getting his way with the ladies...

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: An `old` watch? Why want something old when you can buy something new?
nodes.text_bbcode: An [color=#e23b3b][i]old[/i][/color] watch? Why want something old when you can buy something new?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: He seems exactly like the type to flaunt his wealth...

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: Who even wants a watch?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: And he's just a nerd.
Paige steps up to the group and smiles at each of them.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Hello boys... I'm Paige.

nodes.speaker: Carson
nodes.text: I'm Carson, and this is Preston.

nodes.speaker: Preston
nodes.text: Hey. We've met before.

nodes.speaker: Mark
nodes.text: And I am Mark Backbutter. `Enchante, mademoiselle...`
nodes.text_bbcode: And I am Mark Backbutter. [color=#e23b3b][i]Enchante, mademoiselle...[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Mark takes Paige's hand and lifts it to his mouth to kiss it.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: All right, hotshot...

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: The last few weeks I was here, I forgot that.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: But seeing this ballroom, the glitter, and the glamor... Well, I finally figured out my place.
Whitford stares at her thoughtfully... And smiles.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Good.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: You were right after all, Principal.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I just needed to see it for myself.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: I'm glad we came to this understanding. You are much more clever than I gave you credit for.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Perhaps we'll be seeing you at the Debutante Ball this spring after all.
Whitford walks away, chuckling to herself.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Changed. Inside and out.

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: I'm a completely different person.
Whitford stares at her thoughtfully... Then frowns.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: Do you think me a simpleton, Paige?

nodes.speaker: Paige
nodes.text: Uh, no!

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: I've heard lip service before. I know what it sounds like.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: You don't fool me. You may think you can pander to me to get yourself into my good graces, but you'd be wrong.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: I'll be watching you, Paige. If I were you, I'd be my very best tonight, or you may never graduate from the hallowed halls of this distinguished academy!

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: I hope her concerns are unfounded. I also hope isolation and being back this last week was enough to make you rethink your decisions.

nodes.text: Principal, honestly, you have nothing to worry about.

nodes.text: How can I be so sure that you'll behave?

nodes.text: Mom? Tad? I thought you guys were traveling in Italy.

nodes.text: We came back early.

nodes.text: It was far too Italian over there...

nodes.text: But what are you doing `here` at Monarch?

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: Imagine our surprise to receive a voice message from Principal Whitford asking for our permission for you to leave Monarch Prep during Spring Break.

nodes.speaker: Tad
nodes.text: I was going to pen her a strongly worded letter to tell her that you were under no circumstances to leave the school...

nodes.text: 'Perfect'? That's a bit odd, isn't it?

nodes.speaker: Margot
nodes.text: I think it's wonderful. And we just had to see for ourselves what had changed...

nodes.speaker: Tad

nodes.text: If I'm going to keep my position at the top, I have to go on this trip... But how do I get my parents to go for it?

nodes.text: So tell us more about this Centerscore Beach trip. I thought we sent you to a disciplinary school, not a recreational one...

nodes.text: Paige, do you know where we are?

nodes.text: This is our isolation room at Monarch Prep.

nodes.text: I shouldn't have to tell you that you're in serious trouble. You've violated half a dozen school rules during your trip to the outside world.

nodes.speaker: Whitford
nodes.text: And despite what your parents generously donate to our private paradise here, you won't be getting off unscathed. What do you say to that?

nodes.text: I understand, Principal Whitford.

nodes.text: I hope you enjoyed that little taste of freedom because it's unlikely that you're going to see anything outside these gates in a long while.

nodes.text: I'm not going to be a problem from now on...

A few days after Paige has been cleared to go to Centerscore Beach...
The girls of Monarch Prep gather in Paige's room. Paige reclines on her bed, drinking a smoothie the color of a Brazilian sunset.
Ah, this is the life I've been missing... It's nice to be back at the top.
We're glad to have you back. I can't believe that things have changed so much around here with you as Perfect.
Yeah... Well, it's amazing what you can get away with when your parents are willing to pad your bank account again...
And also when you're willing to generously donate to Whitford's personal funds...
I'm surprised Jessica didn't do it actually. It's like she enjoyed being in a police school.
Speaking of... How did you do it? How did you set her up like that?
Please, Prissy. It was pretty obvious she was giving me that phone to get me in trouble.
There's no reason for her to give it to me otherwise. Especially after she already knew I wasn't going to stay good under her thumb.
And since I was pretty confident she'd do something the night of the ball, I turned the tables on her.
The night before the Emerald Ball...
Paige opens her window and jumps onto the gutter pipe running along the roof of the facility.
And to think, if I'd never tried to escape for `him`, I wouldn't have known which window was Jessica's...
She shimmies along the pipe until she hovers outside Jessica's window. She rams her shoulder into the pane, forcing the shoddily crafted window open.
Inside, she drops into the room, takes the phone from her pocket, and opens the desk drawer. Before putting the phone inside, she admires her handiwork.
An incriminating phone with texts from Ryan. It's a good thing I know his stupid number from his trying to give it to me so many times...
She moves to drop the phone inside the desk when she sees a bottle of glittery nail polish. She nearly laughs with delight.
This is just getting more and more perfect! It's just one more nail in her coffin...
Opening the polish, she paints the initials 'J.B.' on the back of the phone. Waving it around a few times to set it, she shoves the phone in the desk, hops out the window, and closes it behind her.
Good bye, Jessica... Out with the old, and in with the new...
Back in the present, Paige laughs.
Whoa. Remind me not to cross you.
But on to more important matters...
Whitford's letting me bring `one` lucky lady to go to the Debutante Ball at Centerscore Beach...
Come on, Caroline. The second girl is `me.`
So which one of us are you taking?
Because I've been wanting the chance to tan on a beach in, like, forever!
Who said anything about you guys?
Who I take all depends entirely on what you can promise me.
I'm not talking contraband items. We can deal in those later. I'm talking super serious favors.
I have these tickets to a exclusive fashion show!
Ugh, Caroline. Fashion shows are so last year.
And I only take tickets to `super` exclusive events. Next!
I have super-exclusive backstage tickets to a red-carpet event...
I don't want to have a good dress `or` a date for that.
My mom is sending me some real soft-skinned leather products...
My father offered us the use of his boathouse during the summer...
Boathouse? Why should I be impressed by a dinky little boathouse?
It's on my dad's private resort island.
Sounds like Paige is having a lot of fun! And that's your bonus scene!
